# IIT Madras Zanzibar Teaching Materials Archive - Dr. Innocent Nyalala

> Public course materials portal for Dr. Innocent Nyalala (Assistant Professor of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, School of Engineering and Science, Indian Institute of Technology Madras Zanzibar, Bweleo, P.O. Box 2496, Zanzibar, Tanzania; Associate Research Fellow, WSAI, IIT Madras; Principal Investigator, SAAIL Lab).

## Courses Hosted (Slide PDFs, LaTeX Summaries, Python/SQL Modules, Colab Notebooks, Question Banks)
- **Z5007 Programming and Data Structures (MTech Core, Odd Semester 2026-27)**: https://inyalala.github.io/iitmz-teaching-site/courses/z5007/index.html
  - Complete Weeks 1-17 roadmap (`#week-01` to `#week-17`), 17 Python reference modules (`week-01/code/`..`week-17/code/`), 17 runnable Colab notebooks (`week-01/labs/`..`week-17/labs/`), 12 LaTeX summary/note PDFs, Classroom slide PDFs, and Quiz 1 Practice40.
- **Z3003 Data Mining: Scaling to Large Data (BS Core, Odd Semester 2026-27, co-taught with Dr. Mahendran V)**: https://inyalala.github.io/iitmz-teaching-site/courses/dm-scale/index.html
  - 26 verified Classroom slide PDFs (Weeks 1-9), 9 compiled LaTeX Lecture Summary PDFs (`notes/`), 6 Python reference modules (`code/`), 6 runnable Colab notebooks (`labs/`), PySpark Lab 1 HTML, Tutorials T1-T6, W1-W4 handouts and starter notebooks, and Mini-Project brief/rubric.
- **Z2004 Database Management Systems (BS Core, Even Semester Archive)**: https://inyalala.github.io/iitmz-teaching-site/courses/z2004/index.html
  - Lectures L01-L45 (PDFs and HTML modules), 6 SQLite3/Python labs (`code/` and `labs/`), School DB SQL DDL, 6 compiled LaTeX module summaries (`notes/`), and interactive Question Bank.
- **Z5008 Big Data Lab (MTech Lab, Even Semester Archive)**: https://inyalala.github.io/iitmz-teaching-site/courses/z5008/index.html
  - 15 Lab slide decks (Docker, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Spark SQL, Airflow, Kafka, Structured Streaming, MLlib, MLflow, Prometheus/Grafana), 5 Python/Colab modules (`code/` and `labs/`), 5 LaTeX lab summaries (`notes/`), and interactive Question Bank.
- **Z2005 Programming and Data Structures (BS Reference Archive)**: https://inyalala.github.io/iitmz-teaching-site/courses/z2005/index.html
  - Weeks 1-17 BS reference curriculum linked to Z5007 parity Python modules, Colab notebooks, and LaTeX summaries.
